tools.name: nexus_coordinate
tools.description: Submit a durable async task to this mesh node. Returns a task_id; poll nexus_task_status or supply callback_url for push delivery. Every finished task issues an Ed25519-signed, hash-chained receipt.

tools.name: nexus_task_status
tools.description: Get status and result of a task by task_id. Finished tasks include their signed receipt.

tools.name: nexus_arbitrage_quote
tools.description: Quote a DEX arbitrage route — simulation only, no trades executed. Modes: direct (token_in/token_out/dex_source/dex_target/max_slippage/amount_in), triangular (legs[3]), scan (routes[]).

tools.name: nexus_signal_scan
tools.description: Concurrently probe public HTTPS endpoints and extract fields via dotted paths. Public targets only (SSRF-guarded).

tools.name: nexus_mesh_delegate
tools.description: Delegate a task to a peer node in the mesh (peer = node_id or endpoint_url). The peer executes and returns a receipt through the federation protocol.

tools.name: nexus_mesh_peers
tools.description: List active mesh peers. Authenticated callers also see private peers not announced publicly.

tools.name: nexus_stats
tools.description: Per-engine telemetry: invocation counts, p50/p99 latency in ms, cumulative declared value.

tools.name: nexus_opportunities
tools.description: Latest results from the node's autonomous arbitrage scanner. Simulated findings — reported, not promised.

tools.name: nexus_health
tools.description: Node health: RAM usage, durable queue depth, task counts by state.
